scores.note: All 0. 'speak up' here means voicing that the girls are lying. 1 confess and 2 admit change the meaning to confessing his own secret. 3 reveal, 4 disclose, 5 expose, 6 mention, 7 state, 9 assert and 10 say are transitive and leave the sentence without an object (ungrammatical in place). 8 declare likewise needs an object or complement. None works as an intransitive replacement (e.g. protest, object, testify).
